_comment: Independent trap.c landmine setup: seed 7949 was selected from the bounded 7300-8299 mine scan because the D:8 layout places a natural mine beside the independent hero start. Moving one square, #wizgenesis creates a large dog on the mine; u-k steers the hero while the dog enters the mine and falls into the resulting pit. This uses a new seed, clock, character, and input rather than copying a recorded trap case.
